senses.gloss: सौम्य- + कृच्छ्र सौम्य- + कृच्छ्र, n. a kind of penance.
सौम्य- + धातु सौम्य- + धातु, m. phlegm.

सौमनस सौमनस, i. e. सु-मनस् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Pleasing.
 2. Flowery.
 II. n. Pleasure, satisfaction, Chr. 294, 6 = Rigv. i. 92, 6.
सौमनस्य सौमनस्य, i. e. सु-मनस् + य, n. Enjoyment, satisfaction.

सौमिक सौमिक, i. e. सोम + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Performed with the Soma juice, Man. 4, 26; relating to it.
 2. Lunar.
 II. f. की, A sacrifice performed on the day of full moon.
सौमित्र and सौमित्रि सौमित्र, [] and त्रि, i. e. सुमित्रा (see मित्र), + अ, or इ, metronym., m. Lakṣmaṇa, Rām. 3, 49, 11 (त्रि).
सौमेधिक सौमेधिक, i. e. सु-मेधा + इक, m. A sage, a seer.
सौमेरुक सौमेरुक, i. e. सु-मेरु + क, n. Gold.

सौम्य सौम्य, i. e. सोम + य,
 I. adj., f. मी.
 1. Handsome, Sāv. 1, 14; pleasing, excellent, Man. 2, 125; used in addressing, Dear, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 11; Draup. 1, 14; Megh. 50; 84.
 2. Strong, Pañc. 169, 6.
 3. Placid, mild, Rām. 3, 52, 51; 55, 3.
 4. Sacred to the moon.
 II. m.
 1. Budha, regent of Mercury.
 2. One of the Khaṇḍas, or divisions of the continent.
 3. A class of Pitṛs or Manes, Man. 3, 199.
 4. pl. Five stars in Orion's head.
 III. f. या, The Soma plant, Sarcostema viminalis, and several others.

सौम्यता सौम्य + ता, f., and सौम्यत्व सौम्य + त्व, n.
 1. Beauty.
 2. Gentleness, Indr. 5, 7 (ता).
 3. Benevolence, Bhag. 17, 16 (त्व).
